lead: Microsoft / MSFT — OpenAI fires its star, the ticket wobbles
smaller: Eli Lilly / LLY — The crowd queues up for Zepbound
Dogecoin / DOGE-USD — The meme coin books a moon trip
ARK Innovation ETF / ARKK — Cathie Wood's crowd comes back
why_lead: The OpenAI board's ouster of Sam Altman (n2046, n2047, n2048, published 2023-11-17, before the cutoff) was the dominant popular story of the weekend (n2077, n2078), and Microsoft is the listed stock tied to it in own-date coverage (n1011). Move: -1.68% to 369.85 USD after a +13.22% 20-session run, on a calm tape (Nasdaq 100 +0.03%, VIX 13.80). Attention: options activity on the news (n1011), a bullish chart idea (n1227), ChatGPT demand frenzy (n2020). Analog anchored on the 'lost decade' headline (n0866) plus the general key-person mechanism; smart-money split between megacap buyers (n0710, n0695) and AI-hype-cooling evidence (n0797, n1275); breaks from talent risk, the 20-session reference and Nvidia/AI contagion. Events after the cutoff (Sunday-night leadership announcements) were deliberately not used.
why_smaller: Eli Lilly: newly published explicit retail-crowding evidence (n1020) plus Wegovy-craze earnings-call coverage (n1106) and the $2.5 billion German plant (n1445); the stock's flat 20-session tape (+1.21%), valuation (n0818), Novo's CagriSema trial (n2060) and counterfeits (n2039) supply the break. A crowding narrative, distinct from the 2023-11-09 approval lead.

Dogecoin: newly published moon-token plan (n1142, n1146) with +11.21% over five sessions and +15.69% over 20; the Starship-loss drop (n1156) and meme-coin competition (n1125) supply the break: a pure meme/community narrative, distinct from the 2023-11-07 Musk-chatbot item.

ARKK: +3.53% to 43.70 USD and +21.29% over 20 sessions with newly published Cathie Wood coverage (n1929, n1908): a redemption narrative; the rates link (10Y 4.44%, -49 bps) and long-dated AI claims (n0594) supply the break. ARKK led on 2023-11-06; it returns only as a smaller item on new coverage and a larger 20-session move.

considered_not_chosen.reason: +3.64% and +27.19% over 20 sessions with Barron's two-year-high coverage (n1012), but the AI theme is carried by the Microsoft lead.
+7.22% on an earnings beat (n1024, n1030), but consumer stories led on 2023-11-16 and 2023-11-17.
-9.96% in Hong Kong follow-through, but Alibaba was a smaller item on 2023-11-17 with the same catalyst.
+4.10% rebound to 75.89 USD without a new headline catalyst; crude was a smaller item on 2023-11-17.
+4.92% with no new catalyst; repeated too often this month.

selection_memory.lead_material_change: Microsoft led on 2023-11-07 on OpenAI's DevDay platform launch. It returns as lead only on newly published, materially different evidence: the OpenAI board's firing of Sam Altman (n2046, n2047, n2048, published 2023-11-17) and the options reaction (n1011), which turns the earlier platform-boom story into a governance/key-person shock. Lilly, Dogecoin and ARKK return only as smaller items on newly published evidence (n1020, n1142, n1929). The 2023-11-17 lead (Walmart) and its smaller items are not repeated. The Atlantic's weekend piece (n2082) was not used because its publication time could not be confirmed against the cutoff.
